skills.name: Nature's Friend
skills.description:
Receive help by becoming friends with the surrounding nature. Has an even greater effect on weak monsters, which are unable to withstand the power of nature.

Level 3: Also increases Damage for Lara.

skills.name: To Narin!
skills.description: Return to Narin.

skills.name: Mountain Kid
skills.description: Use the essence of the earth to call helpful Mountain Spirits. Mountain Kid is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Peerless Mountain
skills.description: A Mountain Spirit appears to protect you when you are in danger.

skills.name: Response
skills.description: Draw out your potential through a deep communion with nature.

skills.name: Essence Sprinkle
skills.description: Draws out the earth's flowing essence to attack enemies.

skills.name: Jump for Joy!
skills.description: Creates a platform to jump again mid-air to leap farther. Press the Up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Leap Up
skills.description:
Create a platform to jump up high. To activate, press the up arrow key and the jump key at the same time.
Right-click to lock command.

skills.name: Mountain Crash
skills.description: Charges forward like a landslide crashing down a mountain. Also, permanently increases Movement Speed, Max Speed, and Jump.

Eruption Skill
Several River Spirits join together to combine into a giant form. Periodically causes a surge that attacks the surroundings.

skills.name: Eruption: Whirlwind
skills.description:
Eruption Skill
The Wind Spirits periodically exhale a sweeping gust of breath, creating a whirlwind that continuously attacks nearby enemies.

skills.name: Eruption: Sunrise Well
skills.description:
Eruption Skill
Several Sunlight Spirits join together to combine into a frightening giant form, then scatter to cover the surroundings with lava. The lava area periodically creates volcanic bombs that attack enemies within the lava area. Volcanic bombs will first target any boss monsters within the area, starting with the boss with the highest HP.

skills.name: Fortune Fitness
skills.description: Increases Intelligence through physical training.

skills.name: Dragon Vein Eruption
skills.description: Find dormant Dragon Veins and release the power dormant within them. Dragon Veins are found in the order of: sun, river, and wind. Land spirits that match the Dragon Veins' attributes will remain and frolic in the area of eruption. Unaffected by attack reflection. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. The duration of Eruption skills is unaffected by Summon Duration increases, but their strength grows proportionately instead.

skills.name: Mountain Seeds
skills.description:
Plant seeds that grow Mountain Spirits, who then attack nearby enemies and, if there is an active Eruption skill of any attribute within a certain range, will push enemies towards the Eruption skill. You will not take damage while using Mountain Seeds, even when attacking enemies with attack reflection.
Use Mountain Seeds while casting Dragon Vein Eruption to plant seeds without the casting motion, or use with the down arrow key to plant all the seeds at once. In Auto Mode, if seeds are prepared, a Mountain Seed will be planted in the location a Dragon Vein was found each time an Eruption skill is used.
Auto Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Wand Booster
skills.description: Uses MP to temporarily increase your Magic Attack Speed by 2 levels.

skills.name: Dragon Vein Echo
skills.description: Each time you attack an enemy, absorb energy from the Dragon Veins to restore HP and MP and temporarily increase Final Damage. Dragon Vein Echo is not affected by Buff Duration increases. Less effective against bosses, and restores less MP from them.

skills.name: Immaculate Thought
skills.description: Temper the mind to be pure and spotless.

skills.name: Geomancy
skills.description: Increase the power of skills by studying geomancy.

skills.name: Manifestation: Wind Swing
skills.description:
Manifestation Skill
Manifest the power of the wind within a Dragon Vein to create an area with a continuous updraft. Provides a buff that temporarily increases Speed and Jump. Press the Down Arrow key and hold down jump in mid-air within the area to ride a swing, propelled by the wind, and float. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. Permanently increases Attack Speed.
Right-click to toggle the mode for party member use On/Off.

skills.name: Manifestation: Wind Swing
skills.description: Increase Attack Speed, Speed, and Jump through the power of wind.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Manifestation: Where the River Courses
skills.description:
Manifestation Skill
Manifest the power of the river within a Dragon Vein to allow travel along the river's flow. Reuse the skill within a certain period of time to designate the river's end point. After designating an end point, the river will flow continuously between the start and end point, and Lara can press the Up Arrow key at the start point or end point to ride along the river. The end point cannot be designated at portal locations and certain other areas, and this skill cannot be used in some non-hunting maps. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. Riding the river allows you to use a skill that finds Dragon Veins 1 time (excluding Manifestation: Where the River Courses), increases the usable range, and also allows you to use skills that find dragon veins in proportion to the distance traveled.

skills.name: Manifestation: Sunlight-Filled Ground
skills.description:
Manifestation Skill
Manifest the power of sunlight within a Dragon Vein to create an area bathed in the sun's warm glow. Provides a buff that temporarily increases Damage, and the life-giving power of the sun periodically recovers HP within the area. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting.

skills.name: Manifestation: Sunlight-Filled Ground
skills.description: Increases Damage through the warmth of the sun.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Wakeup Call
skills.description: Awaken multiple dormant Dragon Veins in the area, all at once. The awakened Dragon Veins emanate intangible forces, which pursue and attack nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. Tracks the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Dragon Vein Traces
skills.description: Follows the Dragon Veins' traces. Use the Earthly Energy that periodically accumulates in your body to instantly move to a nearby Dragon Vein and attack nearby enemies. Press the arrow keys while using the skill to move in the corresponding direction.

skills.name: Manifestation: Where the River Courses
skills.description: Riding the river allows you to use 1 skill that consumes Dragon Veins (excluding Manifestation: Where the River Courses), increases the skills usable range, and also allows you to use skills that consume Dragon Veins in proportion to the distance traveled.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Absorption: River Puddle Douse
skills.description:
Absorption Skill
When Essence Sprinkle hits, a mischievous River Spirit appears along with a small body of water, and attacks enemies by dousing them. Unaffected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Absorption: Fierce Wind
skills.description:
Absorption Skill
When Essence Sprinkle hits, a Wind Spirit appears and sends a fierce wind at enemies. Unaffected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Absorption: Sunlit Grain
skills.description:
Absorption Skill
When Essence Sprinkle hits, the Sunlight Spirits gather together to emit spheres of condensed sunlight that pursue and attack enemies. Fireballs will first target any boss monsters within the area. If there are multiple boss monsters, the boss with the highest HP will be targeted. Unaffected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Nature Master
skills.description: Become one with nature to better wield its powers. Using Eruption skills allows you to draw out even greater potential from Dragon Veins, increasing the power of Eruption skills. Does not stack with 3rd job Manifestation skill passive effects.

When Essence Sprinkle hits, the Sunlight Spirits gather together to emit spheres of condensed sunlight that pursue and attack enemies. Fireballs will first target any boss monsters within the area. If there are multiple boss monsters, the boss with the highest HP will be targeted. Increases Summon Duration. Unaffected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: HEXA Absorption: Sunlit Grain
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: HEXA Wakeup Call
skills.description: Awaken multiple dormant Dragon Veins in the area, all at once. The awakened Dragon Veins emanate intangible forces, which pursue and attack nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Applies 100% Knockback Resistance during casting. Tracks the boss with the highest HP first. Permanently increases the Final Damage of Eruption and Absorption skills.

skills.name: Universe in Bloom
skills.description:
The Mountain, River, Wind, and Sunlight Spirits gather along a ley line to release a pulse of vibrant, blooming energies.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Universe in Bloom

skills.name: Cornucopia
skills.description:
Inspires the boundless joy of Mother Nature's land spirits to blossom as a flower, purifying enemies with nature's bounty.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
